build_bert_model: build a BERT multimodal language model with cross-attention for vision-language pretraining
create_xbert_encoder: create an XBertEncoder to encode text with visual embeddings for vision-language tasks
generate_xbert_lm_decoder: generate text from visual embeddings using XBertLMHeadDecoder with beam search or nucleus sampling
review_bert_self_attention: review the BertSelfAttention class to understand cross-attention between text and visual features
summarize_bert_layer: summarize the BertLayer class that combines self-attention, cross-attention, and feed-forward chunks
